rows.ja: 再保険の仲介(ブローカー)

companies.name: マーシュ・マクレナン

relations.text: 最大の仲介ブローカー(再保険部門の元受保険料の22.4%)
relations.text_en: Largest broker, 22.4% of reinsurance gross written premiums

source.label: Everest Group 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The broker with the largest share of the company's business, Marsh McLennan, accounted for approximately 22.4% of gross written premiums.

source.label: Everest Group 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The broker with the next-largest share, Aon, accounted for approximately 18.7% of gross written premiums.

relations.text: 米国子会社への再保険回収額が2.89億ドル(5.7%)
relations.text_en: $289 million (5.7%) recoverable from its US unit

source.label: Everest Group 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: $289 million, or 5.7%, was recoverable from Munich Reinsurance America, Inc.

companies.name: ステート・ナショナル

relations.text: 過去の損失12.53億ドル分を出再
relations.text_en: Ceded $1,253 million of covered losses to it

source.label: Everest Group 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, the total covered losses ceded to State National Insurance Company, Inc. were $1,253 million.

relations.text: 4億ドルの未経過限度額を持つ出再先
relations.text_en: Reinsurer with a $400 million unexpired limit

source.label: Everest Group 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The aggregated unexpired limit was $597 million and $400 million for State National Insurance Company, Inc. and MS Transverse Insurance Company, respectively.

relations.text: 商業保険の更新権を2.52億ドルでAIGに売却(2025年10月)
relations.text_en: Sold commercial retail insurance renewal rights to AIG for $252 million (October 2025)

source.label: Everest Group 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: the Company entered into an agreement with American International Group, Inc. ("AIG") to sell the renewal rights for certain lines of commercial retail insurance business written by the Company in the U.S., U.K. and Asia Pacific, for an aggregate purchase price of $252 million.
